subject: Changes in the sidebar does not reflect in all of the tabs

messages.author: b6e2ece08a7a40cb
messages.subject: Changes in the sidebar does not reflect in all of the tabs
parts:
Hi,

I have created a Shiny app which includes two tabs and a sidebar. Whenever I run the app for the first time (which is based on the default values of my app's sidebar), a plot is displayed in the first tab and a table is displayed in the second tab as expected and designed.
However, when I change any parameter in the sidebar, just the plot in the first tab gets updated and the table in the second tab does not change.

Has anyone faced such a case? What would you suggest to deal with this case?

Thank you.
